GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-02-17T09:36:32Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Exception: Nested type Array(String) cannot be inside Nullable type (version 20.9.2.20 (official build))
Description: i was created table:
CREATE TABLE compare.test1
(
	event Nullable(String)
) 
ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple();

when i have construction as 
SELECT
	JSONExtractString(event, 'event_time') as s
	,event
	,splitByChar('T', JSONExtractString(event, 'event_time'))[1]
from compare.test1

i have error:
Exception: Nested type Array(String) cannot be inside Nullable type (version 20.9.2.20 (official build))

When in table i implement event String insted of Nullable(String) it's ok, i don't have any error

You must provide a category number (1-3). Your response must follow this format exactly:

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is a conceptual problem related to ClickHouse SQL syntax and type handling that can be verified without a build environment. The error occurs because the splitByChar function is trying to operate on a potentially NULL value from a Nullable(String) column, and ClickHouse doesn't allow nested Array types inside Nullable types. This is a documented limitation of ClickHouse's type system. The solution (using a non-Nullable String column instead) can be verified through code analysis without needing to run the code. An LLM can analyze the SQL statements, understand the type constraints in ClickHouse, and verify that removing the Nullable wrapper would resolve the issue. This is purely a matter of understanding ClickHouse's type system constraints rather than requiring actual execution of the code.
